funding.title: Funding
funding.help: Write the funder's full name and the grant number from the award letter. The grant number is what lets OpenAIRE link a dataset to the funded project.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.description: You have changes that are not saved. If you leave now, they are lost.

dictionary.purpose: Every column this experiment has recorded. Saying what a column measures lets exports and other researchers read your data without asking you.
dictionary.producerLayoutCaption: The Layout tab names every plot, so these columns need no description.
dictionary.producerUnknownCaption: These readings carry no device details.
dictionary.loadFailed: The columns could not be loaded.
dictionary.empty: No columns yet. They appear once this experiment has readings.
dictionary.readOnly: Only this experiment's admins and members can describe its columns.

describe.intro: Say what this column measures. Only the trait is required.
describe.traitHelp: What the column measures, such as leaf temperature.
describe.methodHelp: How the value was taken, such as a sensor reading at the leaf.
describe.methodPlaceholder: e.g. Sensor reading taken with each measurement
describe.scaleHelp: What kind of values the column holds, such as a measured number or a score from 1 to 9.
describe.unitHelp: The unit of a measured number, such as °C or %. Leave it empty for scores and categories.

term.labelTrait: Crop Ontology term for the trait
term.labelMethod: Crop Ontology term for the method
term.labelScale: Crop Ontology term for the scale
term.traitHelp: The term names the trait in crop trait names. Choose No term fits when none describes the column, which counts it as done.
term.optionalHelp: Optional. A term makes the description match other experiments exactly.
term.hint: Type at least two letters to search.
term.unreachable: The Crop Ontology could not be reached. You can save without a term and add one later.

describe.readOnly: Only this experiment's admins and members can describe its columns.
